overview: The Committee of the Whole convened and voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy regarding Chertog v. City of Medford.

items.title: Executive Session: Chertog v. City of Medford (Item 26-053)
items.summary: The Council approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy in the case of Chertog v. City of Medford, with the meeting adjourning directly from that session.
